description: List records for a custom object schema. Supports filtering, search, pagination, and sorting.

filters.description: JSON-encoded filter conditions for record properties

limit.description: Max number of records to return

offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination

orderBy.description: Field key to sort records by

query.description: Free-text search query to filter records

startAfter.description: Cursor value to start listing after (keyset pagination)

name: crm_list_object_records
